scope: Playable 2003 Black Pearl kits, one reserved flintlock shot, source Jack coin curse and MGS1998 REX radome/cockpit encounter.
sourceMechanicRules: Will uses a forged sword, physical parry and riposte; Elizabeth uses an improvised table knife in her 2003 captive incarnation, without later Pirate King powers or medallion attacks.

Jack has one flintlock shot per battle. Invalid targets, canceled targeting, pause and depleted reserve spend no ammunition; cooldowns, hero switches and waves never reload it. Both Smash players have a visible firing control.

In exact stage269 a living playable 2003 Jack taking his coin gains the curse until restitution. Other heroes remain mortal; an earlier dead Jack is not revived. Protection covers direct/queued damage, external effects, infection, shield and lifedrain.

Jack fires before the final medallions are returned within the condensed finale; lifting the curse makes the shot fatal to Barbossa. Playable Jack becomes mortal immediately on restitution, while the enemy finale lock prevents extra crew deaths until victory.

Stinger fire must hit the source REX cell with valid range and line of sight: radome first, then the open cockpit after summarized Gray Fox assistance. Ordinary body attacks, external damage and raw HP writes cannot win.
Victory disables REX; Liquid survives, and the later fistfight is outside this mission. Genome patrol deaths are not required.
referenceLimits: Konami screenplay/story compendium includes draft-version caveats; radome, Gray Fox laser, Stinger resupply, cockpit and Liquid survival passages agree with the original-game walkthrough.
IMSDB is a draft script: used only as an additional Elizabeth prop reference, not for final-duel chronology.
adaptationLimits: Damage, cooldowns, choreography, numerical resource costs and 2D effects are adapted to existing combat.
The reserved bullet resets only when a new game battle creates the actor; that reset is a crossover gameplay adaptation.
Three ATB ritual commands condense source donors and restitution. The cinematic lock is an engine adaptation, not persistent biological immortality after restitution.

REX remains a stationary grid target. Shared resupplied Stinger, two 360-HP target pools, two-to-six-cell range and Gray Fox offscreen assistance are adaptations. Genome soldiers represent the approach rather than the source duel.
